text: The doctor is sincere and lovely, and all the staff are very attentive to patients. Personally, I trust this place completely and will entrust my oral health to them. 🥰💖👍 …

restaurant_name: พร้อม คลีนิคทันตกรรม
text:
The attentive care is evident from the moment you step into the clinic. Both the doctors and the assistants have helped me gain more confidence in my treatment, even those who are afraid of dental procedures. I've had extractions, scaling, coatings, and root canals.

I highly recommend this place for my entire family's oral and dental health. My children, grandchildren, and grandmother are happy to have their dental work done here.
